items.title: Fintech Dashboard
items.description: A high-frequency trading interface built for institutional investors, processing millions of transactions per second with sub-millisecond latency.
items.details:
## Overview

A high-frequency trading interface built for institutional investors, processing millions of transactions per second with sub-millisecond latency.

## Key Features

- Real-time market data streaming via WebSocket
- Advanced charting with 50+ technical indicators
- One-click trade execution across multiple exchanges
- Institutional-grade risk management & compliance

## Tech Stack

- **Frontend:** React, TypeScript, D3.js
- **Backend:** Node.js, Express, WebSocket
- **Infrastructure:** AWS ECS, Redis, PostgreSQL

items.title: HealthTech App
items.description: A secure, HIPAA-compliant patient management system providing real-time telemetry data to healthcare professionals globally.
items.details:
## Overview

A secure, HIPAA-compliant patient management system providing real-time telemetry data to healthcare professionals globally.

## Key Features

- Real-time patient vitals monitoring
- Secure messaging between providers
- HIPAA-compliant data storage & transmission
- Cross-platform mobile & tablet support

## Tech Stack

- **Mobile:** Swift (iOS), Kotlin (Android)
- **Backend:** Go, gRPC
- **Infrastructure:** GCP, Cloud SQL, Firebase

items.details:
## Overview

A high-throughput e-commerce platform designed for flash sales and high-traffic events.

## Key Features

items.title: Analytics Engine

items.details:
## Overview

A real-time data analytics platform for enterprise clients processing massive data volumes.

## Key Features

- 10TB+ daily data processing pipeline
- Custom dashboard builder with drag-and-drop

- Multi-tenant architecture with RBAC

## Tech Stack

- **Backend:** Python, Apache Kafka, Spark
- **Frontend:** React, D3.js, WebGL
- **Infrastructure:** GCP, BigQuery, Dataflow
